correctness.rationale: For all positive a,b,c, exact six-class ordered arclength partition gives f_D(0+)=2/L, M=c+(a+b)/2, and the two explicit moments. Writing s=a+b, p=ab, the mean coefficient in p is c-s/4; only at c=s/4 does it vanish, and the second moment there is B2+s^2 p/48+p^2/12, strictly increasing for 0<p<=s^2/4. Hence s,p,c determine both lengths including ties; a concrete nonisometric pair shares L,M,mean. Recomputed density normalization and analytic moments, checked the positive root and exact endpoint. The packaged checker independently passed exact and grid diagnostics but these are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: This natural two-cycle network has a nontrivial cancellation threshold c=(a+b)/4: at fixed total length and diameter, infinitely many loop splits become indistinguishable by average distance; crossing the threshold reverses the mean-distance optimum. One additional distance moment provably repairs exactly this degeneracy, giving a complete global inverse theorem rather than a routine numerical example.
